title: Excellent service
content:
I went to help someone talk about their illness. The doctor was absolutely amazing and I didn't really need to be there at all because she gave the person time to talk.
The reception team have also been very helpful when I was registering and making appointments etc.
The new modern building is clean and well designed.
real_data_note: Verbatim real patient review (4-5 star), used as a positive practice exemplar for retrieval grounding. Not an authored policy document.
